title: logit25: does the logistic half of the official blend improve when trained on ~2.5 years instead of the last 120 days?
question: Hourly radar labels now exist for 2014-2026 (fra.labels history labels) and archived ECMWF IFS single runs from 2024-03-14. Phase 2 found 'all history' ~= 120 d, but its history only reached back to Jun 2025 and was sparsely labelled before 2026-02-11. Is a longer training window better now?

inputs.labels: fra.labels.history_labels(gap_rule='confirmed') = load_counts(include_history=True, complete_only=True, gap_rule='confirmed') -> to_labels(bridge='night') (as experiments/history12/run.py history_labels('confirmed'); RWY 18 not judged in confirmed suspect hours). In-memory only; data/labels.parquet is not touched.
inputs.ifs: data/ifs_runs_backfill.parquet + data/ifs_runs.parquet (surface) and data/ifs_runs_upper_backfill.parquet + data/ifs_runs_upper.parquet (100 m wind), concatenated into experiments/logit25/inputs/ (shared files untouched). Same as-of rule as production (newest init <= issue - 6 h); before 2024-08-09 18 UTC only 00/12 UTC runs exist, so older runs are used there.
inputs.prognosis: data/prognosis_history.parquet (asof <= 2025-04-30 23 UTC) + data/prognosis.parquet (from 2025-05-01), concatenated into experiments/logit25/inputs/.
inputs.icon: ICON-D2 / ICON-EU archives as production (from 2026-04/05); before that the consensus is ECMWF alone, as in production.
inputs.table: fra.dataset.build with the merged inputs (module paths pointed at the merged files in-process), lag 2 h, ICON-EU fill, leads 1..48, issues 2024-03-14 .. 2026-10-30 (valid < 2026-11-01) -> experiments/logit25/inputs/table.parquet. Clean-label filter: the labels are already night-bridged, so fra.train's direct-label mask is pointed at the same labels (every table row counts as directly observed).
inputs.decision_rollout: stored blend-v2 decision predictions: experiments/integration/preds_long.parquet column p_dec_main (sha256 prefix 70f2e7c3cc152ce2); blend-v2 = p_blend_main = 0.5 p_logit + 0.5 p_dec_main

test.period: long test: issue 2026-06-01 .. 2026-10-30 (valid < 2026-11-01), 22 weekly walk-forward folds (fra.evalkit.folds); training rows = outcome published before the week start (valid + 2 h <= week start)
test.rows: identical (issue, lead) rows for every method: rows of experiments/integration/preds_long.parquet (the blend-v2 long-test rows, 173,352) where every candidate has a prediction; truth = its od column (same truth as the blend-v2 evaluation)
test.metrics: primary Brier(1,6,24,48) of P(OD 25) pooled over leads 1/6/24/48; also Brier over all leads 1..48 and accuracy (p > 0.5) per lead 1/6/24/48
test.ci: paired day-block bootstrap (fra.evalkit.bootstrap, UTC days of the valid time, 2000 reps, seed fra.evalkit.SEED, 95 %); decisive = 1-day blocks; 3-day blocks reported as sensitivity (not decisive)
test.holdout: no issue or valid time >= 2026-11-01 is used for training, tuning or scoring

stage_1.what: logit alone, each candidate vs the control on identical rows
stage_1.control: w120_T: production spec (fra.train.fit: C 0.03, 4 lead buckets, temperature scaling, last 120 days) on the extended table

candidates.what: 0.5 x wall_T + 0.5 x LightGBM with monotone constraints trained on all history (settings of experiments/phase2 lgbm_mono: production logit features + lead + run_age_h; P(OD 25) non-increasing in tw25, tw25_roll6, tw25_prev3, tw25_next3, tw25_100m, tw25_cons, tw25_cons_roll6, tw25_pastmin6, non-decreasing in prog_signed, prog_alt_signed, rule_od25, od_now25; 300 trees, lr 0.03, 7 leaves, min_child_samples 200, reg_lambda 10, subsample 0.8 freq 1, colsample 0.8, n_jobs 1, seed 0)

stage_1.also_reported: control vs the stored production logit (p_logit of preds_long.parquet): max |diff| and paired Brier, to show how far the extended table moves the 120-day control

stage_2.what: the selected candidate INSIDE the blend: 0.5 x candidate logit + 0.5 x p_dec_main, vs blend-v2 (p_blend_main), identical rows
stage_2.selection: selected candidate = the stage-1 passer with the lowest whole-test paired Brier(1,6,24,48) difference vs the control. If no candidate passes stage 1, the candidate with the lowest stage-1 point estimate is still scored inside the blend as a diagnostic (counted), but cannot be adopted.

adoption_rule.text: A candidate becomes a SHADOW variant only if it passes the rule in stage 1 (vs the control) AND in stage 2 (in the blend vs blend-v2). The rule: (1) the 95 % CI of the paired Brier(1,6,24,48) difference lies entirely below 0 on the whole long test; (2) the point estimate is below 0 in both halves H1 (Jun-Jul) and H2 (Aug-Oct); (3) no lead 1/6/24/48 is significantly less accurate (no paired accuracy-difference CI entirely below 0).
adoption_rule.never: an adopted candidate never becomes the official forecast here; it is registered as a shadow challenger (blend-logit25) pre-registered in experiments/integration/preregistration_logit25.json, judged on live issue hours after its registration, and never replaces the champion during the holdout

if_adopted: fit on all rows whose outcome is published before 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC (valid + 2 h <= 2026-11-01), RWY 18 part copied unchanged from blend-v2's model.pkl -> data/archive/models/blend-logit25/model.pkl (+ copy of blend-v2 decision_model.pkl, blend-v2 library); smoke in runtime 2026-10-31-wave2-r5 with a candidate registry; preregistration_logit25.json; amendment A9; atomic registry install with a backup; check the next hourly run
selection_noise: every scored variant is counted (stage 1: 9 incl. the control and the optional LightGBM blend; stage 2: 1). Phase 2 scored 21 variants and the integration round ~42 on the same test; the long test is in-sample for the blend design, so the holdout / live record is the referee.
outputs: experiments/logit25/run.py, inputs/ (merged inputs + table), preds/*.parquet, results.csv, results.json
